branches.branch_image_en: the side hair of the head beside the ears
branches.what_is_ar: جانبا الرأس ومعظم شعر اللمة مما يلي الأذنين وظهور الشيب في الفَوْدَيْن والضفيرتان إذا قيل فَوْدان
branches.what_is_en: The head's two sides and the main side-hair near the ears, including gray appearing at the two fawds and the two braids when called fawdan.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الفَوْد معظم شعر اللمة مما يلي الأذنين (maqayis)؛ فَوْد الرأس جانباه (sihah)؛ بدا الشيب بفَوْدَيْه (sihah)؛ إذا كان للرجل ضفيرتان يقال لفلان فَوْدان (sihah)
branches.review_note: Maqayis presents this as the base word of the root. Analytical split: Maqayis bundles this base image with the eagle-wing metaphor under كلمة واحدة ثم تستعار; B002 separates the metaphor for Pass 3 assignability. Sihah also includes the two-braid subcase in the same entry.

branches.what_is_ar: جناحا العقاب إذا سميا فَوْدَيْن على سبيل الاستعارة
branches.what_is_en: The eagle's two wings when named fawdan by metaphorical extension.
branches.review_note: Maqayis explicitly marks this as a metaphorical borrowing from the base head-side image. Analytical split: Maqayis bundles the base image and this metaphor under كلمة واحدة ثم تستعار; B001 and B002 separate them for Pass 3 assignability.

branches.branch_image_en: between the two paired loads or counterparts
branches.image_en_gap_note: The source glosses the idiom only as بين العدلين, so the English bridge is approximate.
branches.what_is_ar: القعود بين العدلين في عبارة قعد بين الفَوْدَيْن
branches.what_is_en: The idiom of sitting between the two paired counterparts in the expression qa'ada bayna al-fawdayn.
branches.source_phrase_ar: قعد بين الفَوْدَيْن أي بين العدلين
branches.review_note: Sihah lists this expression in the entry without deriving it from the head-side image; it is separated for Pass 3 assignability.
